measurement: Order the calf liner in the same size as the Rebound DUAL OTS brace already in use, XS to 3XL. Brace sizing is based on thigh circumference measured 6 in. (15 cm) above mid patella. No new measurement is required to order a replacement liner. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
